title: schoolz / User experience
description: Did anyone come, where from, did they convert, and did the site work for them.

panels.title: Visits by page (server-side, last 30d)
panels.description: The reliable number: counted server-side, so ad blockers don't hide it. Aggregate only - one row per day/page/source, nothing per visitor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS "Day", path AS "Page", sum(count) AS "Visits"
FROM page_visits
WHERE day >= to_char(now() - interval '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC;

panels.title: Where visitors came from (last 30d)
panels.description: 'facebook' is the campaign cohort. First-touch per browser session, so a reader who lands from Facebook and clicks through stays attributed to Facebook.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source AS "Source", sum(count) AS "Visits"
FROM page_visits
WHERE day >= to_char(now() - interval '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Survey funnel (last 30d)
panels.description: The question the Facebook post is actually asking: how many read it, how many opened the survey, how many finished.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(count), 0) FROM page_visits
     WHERE path = '/chcomms' AND day >= to_char(now() - interval '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS "Read /chcomms",
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(count), 0) FROM page_visits
     WHERE path = '/survey' AND day >= to_char(now() - interval '30 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS "Opened /survey",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM survey_responses
     WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS "Completed survey";

panels.title: Newsletters submitted by the community (last 30d)
panels.description: The single most valuable conversion - a submitted Smore link is what makes a school's page fill in.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS "Submissions"
FROM community_submissions
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: What parents say is hard to find
panels.description: Directly answers whether the report's priorities match what parents actually feel. A topic nobody picks is one we guessed wrong about.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(pain_points::jsonb) AS "Topic", count(*) AS "Picked by"
FROM survey_responses
WHERE jsonb_typeof(pain_points::jsonb) = 'array'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Page views by route (RUM)
panels.description: RUM's view of the same traffic as panel 1. Lower than the server-side count by roughly the ad-blocker rate - the gap between the two is itself informative.

panels.title: CTA clicks on /chcomms (RUM)
panels.description: Which of the three asks actually converts: send_newsletter, take_survey, or try_app.

panels.title: Core Web Vitals p75 by route
panels.description: Largest Contentful Paint, the vital Google actually ranks on.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app_name="schoolz-faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | unwrap lcp [1h]) by (route)

panels.title: JavaScript errors by route (RUM)
panels.description: Catches the class of bug that blanked every local build (faro-react's FaroRoutes) before a user has to report it.
